$comment: A minimal provider of forecast items (EDP 1.0): a prediction market or forecasting site. Documentation only.

Target forecast (prompt 138) records each item as a forecast of the external forecaster edp:ext-market-odds-example/odds (type external) on a ledger question: the question its questionRef names, or the one its question.externalId is linked to with POST /v1/external/sources/ext-market-odds-example/question-links {streamId, externalQuestionId, questionId, orientation}.

A forecast is recorded on the first item, on a move of at least 0.02 and otherwise daily; made_at is when Foresignal recorded it, never before receipt. External forecasters are scored like every forecaster and join the ensemble only after 30 resolved linked questions.

question.title: Will the strait close to commercial traffic before 2027?
